uses.text: Ampreloxetine (INN, USAN; developmental code name TD-9855) is a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (NRI) which is under development for the treatment of symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (NOH). As of November 2023, ampreloxetine is in phase 3 clinical trials for NOH.
